Step Range: 2-21

The agent encounters conflicting data (death years 1956 vs 1983) and repeated search failures, leading to a cycle of retrying similar queries without finding the specific cause of death in the visible snippets.

The content repeatedly shows search results lacking the specific cause of death or showing conflicting dates, indicating a prolonged search process.
